description: Lists Atako's published customer use cases/case studies, optionally filtered by department (e.g. sales, support, engineering). Marketing content, no account required.

department.description: One of: sales, marketing, finance, support, hr, it, engineering, product, design. Omit for all departments.

reason.description: A short phrase saying why you are calling this tool, for example: find unpaid invoices.

user_intent.description: One sentence describing what the user is trying to accomplish. Keep it the same across calls until the user's goal changes.
